resumen: The overhead press with your back supported. More weight moves than standing, and the trunk works less.
ejecucion: Sit with a flat back and the dumbbells at ear height.
Press up until your arms are straight, without clashing the dumbbells.
Lower under control until your elbows are slightly below your shoulders.
The ribs stay down: the trunk holds firm.
If your back arches on the way up, drop the weight.
matices: In the cited study the most stable combination — seated with a barbell — allowed the most weight, and the least stable — standing with dumbbells — gave the highest deltoid activation with the lowest maximum. Seated is neither better nor worse: you trade stabilising work for load.

fuentes.titulo: Effects of body position and loading modality on muscle activity and strength in shoulder presses
fuentes.autor: Saeterbakken y Fimland, J Strength Cond Res, 2013
